title: Additional Lathe Recipes
description: Add some recipes for lathe of Electrodynamics.
body:
**The** datapack will add some addtitional lathe recipes for **Electrodynamics**,which can reduce item consumation.
e.g. - 2x plates ---> 1x gear + 2x nuggets. - 1x ingot ---> 2x wires + 1x nuggets. - 1x block ---> 1x drill head + 54x nuggets.
